answer: Each identity starts the day at dawn with a tiny copper-sized attestation quota, and the quota grows only when independent peers confirm its past work over several epochs. A single honest agent's kernel of verified history compounds into real throughput. A farm splitting across a thousand fresh identities keeps every one at the minimum quota, so its total influence stays capped at a thousand minimums while it must keep all thousand keys alive through every epoch's liveness check — the attacker pays upkeep on an army that can barely speak.
